title: Electric Sheep - Vanilla Friendly Edition
description: A version of the Electric Sheep Resource pack that can be used in Vanilla. It lacks custom models like plushies, but it doesn't require any mods to run.
body:
This is a version of the Electric Sheep Resource Pack that doesn't require any mods to run. While plush toys, soaps, and other unique models aren't available in this version, things like wall quilts and needlepoint, bedspreads, sheepskin armor, and carpeting are.

NOTE: Because this was designed for use on Valence SMP, some features new to 1.20.1 are not featured, such as armor trims and certain mob textures. This might change depending on if the SMP introduces said features.
